p.i: Et mulcere animos, & pectora flectere dictis, Nec semel astra super coelique volubilis orbes Mente fugit, fruiturque Deo, secretaque summi Aetheris interras defert, hoc scilicet illum Omnipotens GENITOR magno dignatur honore Contemptis pro divitiis, fastuque parentum, Nam leges Benedictas tuas, & facta sequutus Crescentem instituit tua per vestigia vitam, Deseruitque domum, atque adytis se se abdidit ultro, Ille manu ostentans nostrae monumenta salutis Pendentem ligno, & patientem mortis iniquae Bis genitum Regem, pedibus per scrupea nudis It primam ante aciem, plenoque haec ingerit ore Hoc Duce vincendum o Comites, hoc fidite signo.

page.notes: Verse lines are printed as set in italic with long s rendered as plain s; "ingerit ore" has a struck-through word-end on "ore" as printed in the scan. The woodcut ornament is an unnumbered decorative block and is not transcribed.
